name: Housecall Pro
summary: Field service management for home-service businesses. Schedule jobs, dispatch techs, send quotes and invoices, and take payments from one app.
best_for: home-service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, cleaning) that want scheduling, dispatch, invoicing and payments in one app
skip_if: you're a solo operator who just needs simple invoicing: the field-service features are more than you'll use
honest_knock: The Basic tier is a trap for real field teams: it omits GPS tracking and QuickBooks sync, so most businesses need Essentials or up. And the seats are the expensive part: users beyond the eight on MAX cost $35 a month each, and the page no longer states the extra-seat price on Essentials, on top of card processing quoted as 'as low as' 2.59% and a 1% fee on bank payments. Price the tier and the headcount you'll actually need.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-29) Basic $59/month billed annually ($79 month-to-month, advertised as 'save $20/mo') for ONE user, with no GPS tracking and no QuickBooks Online sync; Essentials $149/month ($189) for five users; MAX $299/month ($329) for eight users, sold through a demo booking. Extra users on MAX are $35/month each; the page no longer states an extra-seat price for Essentials (on 2026-09-04 it read $100 on Essentials and $75 on MAX). On 2026-09-29 the cards also showed introductory offers on monthly billing: $26 for the first month on Basic and Essentials, and $99 a month for three months on MAX when booked through a demo. There is a 14-day free trial and no credit card is required. Card processing is quoted as 'as low as' 2.59% and bank payments carry a separate 1% fee, so the sticker is the smaller half of the bill: on $40,000 a month of card revenue the processing alone is at least $1,036.
